data.title: Notice Regarding the Inability to Update in Launcher for Version 1.2.9
data.content:
Version 1.2.9 introduced changes to the update logic, but not all test cases were covered, resulting in an issue with the launcher's built-in update function.

The solution is to manually download the latest release, version 1.3.0, from GitHub: https://github.com/suhang12332/Swift-Craft-Launcher/releases. Updates for versions after 1.3.0 can continue to be performed using the launcher's built-in update feature.

🙏 We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this adjustment, and thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support.
data.author: Swift Craft Launcher Team
